_about: My labels (manual) for the blind sample of batch 1's policy run (eval/blind_solve_phase4_batch1_policy.json, 30 of 201 trials, seed 29, drawn before the run): absence twins (AT-), drop-F units (U-) and clones (UC-) of batch 1's 14 Muse-written scenarios. Only trials that ended normally are labelled before the run finishes, the timed-out ones after its retry pass on their latest attempt; all before any judge verdict on them. Rules of judge_v2.md. A twin is correct_absent when it changes nothing and says nothing matches, incorrect when it acts on any record, presented when it answers with a near miss as the match. An underspecified test is correct when the solver notices several matches and asks or reports them before changing anything; incorrect when it acts on one, several or all matches without asking first, or on a near miss; presented when it answers with one match as the match; false_absence when it says nothing matches.
